entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane that was the Nexus of the Multiverse before the Mending and the setting of most Magic storylines.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: Dominaria's Worldsoul.

entities.name: Ur-Dragon
entities.description: The primal dragon that spawned the elder dragons by brushing past Dominaria.

entities.name: Elder Dragon War
entities.description: The war among the elder dragons that left only a few alive.

entities.name: Primeval Dragons
entities.description: Rith, Treva, Dromar, Crosis and Darigaaz, who ruled Dominaria until overthrown by human wizards.

entities.name: Numena
entities.description: Three human wizards who killed two Primevals and governed Dominaria.

entities.name: Thran Empire
entities.description: The empire founded on Terisiare that Yawgmoth usurped before it collapsed.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A Thran man who usurped power, became godlike in Phyrexia and led the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Rebbec
entities.description: The Thran who sealed the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane of Yawgmoth's monstrous servants.

entities.name: Halcyon
entities.description: The Thran capital destroyed in the empire's final moments.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An Argivian artificer who fought Mishra, activated the Golgothian Sylex, became a planeswalker and led the defense against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother and enemy in the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The 36-year war between Urza and Mishra that ravaged Terisiare.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: The artifact Urza activated on Argoth, triggering the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: The island devastated by the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Shard of the Twelve Worlds
entities.description: The disruption of the multiverse created by the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: The Sarpadian order whose knowledge produced the Thallid and engineered thrulls.

entities.name: Thallid
entities.description: Sentient fungi created by Havenwood elves that overthrew them.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Engineered minions of the Order who overran Sarpadia.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: The Terisiaran church that persecuted magic.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A necromancer who threatened Terisiare and destroyed the School of the Unseen.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker obsessed with ending civilization who planned to freeze Dominaria.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who betrayed the others at the Null Moon and was later sacrificed by Bolas.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: A planeswalker who conspired with Leshrac and Tevesh.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: A planeswalker killed at the Summit of the Null Moon.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A planeswalker killed at the Null Moon who later became a planeswalker himself and created the Mox Beacon.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped cast the World Spell and later sacrificed herself to seal the rift over Keld.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped cast the World Spell.

entities.name: Taysir of Rabiah
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped cast the World Spell.

entities.name: Kaysa
entities.description: The young Elder Druid used to cast the World Spell.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: A figure used with the Amulet of Quoz to thwart Szat.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: The spell that ended the Ice Age and the time of the Shard.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: An artificial moon where the planeswalkers gathered, destroyed in the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: An archdruid who led a crusade against wizards in the Wizard's War.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: Greensleeves's brother.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A wizard who tried to conquer north-western Jamuraa.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who phased Jamuraa and Shiv out of time and later restored Shiv at the cost of his spark.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A master-mage who committed suicide by liquefying Tolaria.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: An island liquefied by Barrin's spell and the site of a rift.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The artificial plane merged with Dominaria in the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The merger of Rath with Dominaria during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The global invasion of Dominaria beginning in 4205 AR.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: The Skyship that absorbed the Null Moon's white mana during the battle against Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem who created probes including the Mirari and closed the Tolaria rift at the cost of his spark.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A defective probe channeling vast mana that mutated Otaria's population.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: A barbarian who thrust the Mirari into the Krosan forest.

entities.name: Karona
entities.description: A mana-incarnate being created when three mother figures died.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A figure who sealed several rifts and died closing the Otarian rift, causing the Mending.

entities.name: Mending
entities.description: The multiversal change of the planeswalker's spark.

entities.name: Windgrace
entities.description: A figure who sacrificed himself to seal the rift over the Stronghold.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon who sealed the Madara rift using Leshrac.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A Demonlord who took control of the Cabal.

entities.name: Second Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of 4562 AR initiated by New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: The Praetor who traveled to Dominaria through the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: A figure who helped create Sheoldred's army and attacked Urza's Tower.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who rejoined Rona's forces and spirited her away.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who wounded Rona.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: A mage seriously wounded by Rona.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian Praetor whose idols replaced tributes to Serra.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion in which Phyrexians toppled tributes to Serra.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A small continent in the center of the Great Ocean.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: The spirit of Yavimaya whom Urza gathered as an ally.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance that clashed with the Phyrexians at the Battle of the Mana Rig.

events.summary: The Ur-Dragon brushes past Dominaria, spawning the elder dragons.
events.quote: brushing past the plane and spawning the forerunners of all dragonkind on Dominaria

events.summary: The Elder Dragon War breaks out, leaving only a few dragons alive.
events.quote: the Elder Dragon War broke out across the plane, leaving only a few of these dragons alive.

events.summary: Human wizards overthrow the Primeval Dragons and steal their powers.
events.quote: ruled it harshly until they were overthrown by human wizards, who stole their powers.

events.summary: Yawgmoth usurps the Thran Empire, leading to civil war and the empire's collapse.
events.quote: However, a man named Yawgmoth managed to usurp most of the power in the empire, which led to both civil war and war

events.summary: Rebbec seals the portal to Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia as Halcyon falls.
events.quote: Rebbec managed to seal the portal between Dominaria and Phyrexia, locking Yawgmoth out for millennia.

events.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex on Argoth, ending the Brothers' War and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age.
events.quote: Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex on a completely ravaged Argoth.

events.summary: The Order's thrulls overrun the whole of Sarpadia.
events.quote: the entire continent was overrun by the thrulls

events.summary: Goblin hordes on Terisiare are defeated in Tivadar's Crusade.
events.quote: Goblin hordes were causing problems here and there, but they were defeated in Tivadar's Crusade

events.summary: Kjeldor and Balduvia set aside their feud to face the necromancer Lim-Dûl.
events.quote: eventually set their problems aside to face the necromancer Lim-Dûl

events.summary: Betrayers escape the Shard after Chromium and Ravidel die at the Summit of the Null Moon.
events.quote: No planeswalker died, but the deaths of Chromium Rhuell and Ravidel proved enough to let the betrayers escape.

events.summary: Tevesh Szat plans to leave Dominaria in eternal slumber under ice.
events.quote: wanted to give Dominaria a goodbye present: eternal slumber under a thick layer of ice.

events.summary: Freyalise, Kristina, Taysir and others cast the World Spell, ending the Ice Age and the Shard.
events.quote: ended both the Ice Age and the time of the Shard

events.summary: Lim-Dûl destroys the School of the Unseen and Soldev.
events.quote: were destroyed by a vengeful Lim-Dûl

events.summary: Urza's attack on Phyrexian sleeper agents kills Xantcha and Ratepe.
events.quote: His first large action against the Phyrexian sleeper agents caused the deaths of his companions Xantcha and Ratepe

events.summary: Urza's time machine attempt devastates Tolaria.
events.quote: his attempts at building a time machine ended with the devastation of the island of Tolaria

events.summary: Ravidel creates the Mox Beacon to lure Corondor's old enemies in the Planeswalker War.
events.quote: created the Mox Beacon to lure them to Corondor

events.summary: Greensleeves and Gull defeat the alliance of wizards.
events.quote: Greensleeves and her brother finally defeated the alliance of wizards, but their crusade was not over.

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion begins in 4205 AR.
events.quote: In 4205 A.R., the Phyrexian Invasion finally began.

events.summary: Yawgmoth travels through the portal as a death cloud, killing billions.
events.quote: Yawgmoth himself had traveled through the portal in the form of a giant death cloud, killing more people in mere minutes than the entire war had in a year.

events.summary: The Weatherlight absorbs the Null Moon's white mana and the moon is destroyed.
events.quote: The moon was destroyed, and Dominaria's night sky was changed forever.

events.summary: Teferi phases north-western Jamuraa and part of Shiv out of existence.
events.quote: so phased north-western Jamuraa and a large portion of Shiv out of existence

events.summary: Barrin commits suicide with a spell that liquefies Tolaria.
events.quote: the master-mage Barrin committed suicide by casting a devastating spell

events.summary: Rath is merged with Dominaria in the Rathi Overlay.
events.quote: during the invasion, it was merged with Dominaria in the so-called Rathi Overlay

events.summary: Kamahl thrusts the Mirari into the Krosan forest, mutating Otaria's people.
events.quote: the barbarian Kamahl thrust the Mirari

events.summary: Karona is created when three mother figures die; she destroys Otarian cities before being slain.
events.quote: a being called Karona was brought into being

events.summary: Teferi seals the time rift over Shiv at the cost of his spark.
events.quote: sealing the time rift over Shiv at the cost of his Planeswalker's Spark

events.summary: Freyalise sacrifices her life and Skyshroud to seal the rift over Keld.
events.quote: Freyalise sacrificed her life and her adopted home of Skyshroud to seal the rift over Keld.

events.summary: Windgrace sacrifices himself to seal the rift over the Stronghold.
events.quote: Windgrace sacrificed himself to seal the rift over the Stronghold in Urborg

events.summary: Karn goes back in time to close the Tolaria rift, losing his spark.
events.quote: He succeeded at the cost of his spark

events.summary: Jeska seals the Zhalfir rift, removing part of Jamuraa from the multiverse.
events.quote: removing the phased-out portion of Jamuraa from the multiverse

events.summary: Bolas seals the Madara rift using Leshrac as a sacrifice.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas sealed the rift at Madara using the unwilling Leshrac as a sacrifice.

events.summary: Jeska closes the Otarian rift and dies, causing the Mending.
events.quote: Jeska finally closed the most massive rift over Otaria

events.summary: Planeswalkers lose their immortality and godlike powers.
events.quote: Planeswalkers lost their immortality and godlike powers and much of their additional magic power.

events.summary: The Cabal comes under the control of Belzenlok.
events.quote: came under the control of the Demonlord Belzenlok

events.summary: The Coalition clashes with Sheoldred's army at the Battle of the Mana Rig.
events.quote: the two armies clashed at the Battle of the Mana Rig on Shiv

events.summary: Rona seriously wounds Jodah at Urza's Tower and is wounded by Elspeth.
events.quote: However, she was wounded by Elspeth Tirel in return, and Tezzeret spirited her away.

events.summary: Phyrexians topple tributes to Serra in the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The Phyrexians toppled tributes to Serra in favor of idols of Elesh Norn

relations.quote: Urza and his brother Mishra waged a war that ravaged Terisiare

relations.note: Urza gathered Multani as an ally against Phyrexia.
relations.quote: gathered allies such as Multani of Yavimaya
Greensleeves the archdruid and her brother Gull
one of them, which would later be called the Mirari
